snippet.title: The Zium Railway - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
In the valley of the Underground Mountain...
In the picturesque land of Lyptch...

Experience a hand crafted open world, 
the open rails, 
a new collection of artists, 
a collaborative video game,
and a new exhibition from The Zium Society.

Announcing...

The Zium Railway

featuring:
Ada Null
Charlotte Madelon
Christopher Ferris
Farfama
Jacob Potterfield
John Flannelly & Virtual Neighbors
Julian Palacios
Michael Berto
Pippin Barr
Zilasaule

The Zium Railway is a virtual art gallery game, featuring work from artists from around the world. This installment of The Zium series features a hand-crafted open world by artist Jacob Potterfield. Within this world, explorable on foot or via The Z Train, there are train stations which each contain works from eight individual artists, as well as from curator Michael Berto and world artist Jacob Potterfield. At these stations, there are individual Process Galleries, exploring glimpses into the process of the artists in the creation of their featured works. At The Welcome Center of The Zium Railway, the centrepiece of the open world, you can find a similar exploration from Jacob Potterfield, art director, and Michael Berto, developer, curator and founder of The Zium.

The Zium is created and curated by
Michael Berto

The Zium Railway Credits:
Game Direction/Curation: Michael Berto
Main World Art Direction and World Builder: Jacob Potterfield
featured artists:
Ada Null
Charlotte Madelon
Christopher Ferris
Farfama
Jacob Potterfield
John Flannelly & Virtual Neighbors
Julian Palacios
Michael Berto
Pippin Barr
Zilasaule

The Zium Railway is a virtual art gallery game, featuring work from artists from around the world. It will be available as a free download from September 13th 2026.


www.thezium.art/theziumrailway
